hero.headline: Stop losing money to expired stock.
hero.lead: Batch-level inventory across every branch, First-Expiry-First-Out deduction at the counter, and race-safe sales. So two cashiers can never oversell the last unit.
hero.sampleHint: Receipts carry batch costs so profit per branch is honest, not averaged.

problem.title: Three problems every pharmacy chain hits.
problem.body: Expiry losses. Phantom stock-outs. No clear view of which branch actually makes money. This system is built to kill all three.

problem1.title: Expired on one shelf, out-of-stock on another
problem1.body: Without batch-level visibility and transfers, stock rots in one branch while another runs dry.

problem2.title: Manual counting, silent errors
problem2.body: No batches, no audit trail. A missing box looks like theft three weeks later. Too late to recover.

problem3.title: Owners can't see profit per branch
problem3.body: Averaged costs hide which branches are profitable. Decisions get made on hunches.

features.title: Features
features.lead: Every rule in the Somalia 10X Challenge Project 09 brief, built and tested.

fefo.title: FEFO at the counter
fefo.body: Every sale takes from the earliest-expiring batch first. Expired batches never sell.

concurrency.title: Race-safe sales
concurrency.body: Two cashiers racing for the last unit? Exactly one wins. The other sees a clean out-of-stock message.

transfers.title: Inter-branch transfers
transfers.body: Requested → Approved (HQ above $500) → Dispatched → Received with the same batch number and expiry.

expiry.title: Expiry dashboard
expiry.body: Buckets for 30 / 60 / 90 days with colour-coded risk and total value at cost.

profit.title: Honest profit per branch
profit.body: Cost comes from each batch actually sold. Never averaged. Returns net off revenue AND cost.

controlled.title: Controlled drugs register
controlled.body: Pharmacist-only, prescription required, database triggers block any edit or delete.

step1.title: Scan or search
step1.body: Barcode or name lookup. Add to cart. Price is HQ-controlled and the same at every branch.

step2.title: Pick payment
step2.body: Cash, EVC Plus, Zaad, eDahab. All behind a simulated adapter interface.

step3.title: FEFO deducts
step3.body: SELECT…FOR UPDATE on batches ordered by expiry. The second cashier sees the updated stock. No race.

step4.title: Receipt out
step4.body: Sequential receipt number (no gaps on failure), printable, COPY stamp on re-print.

cta.title: Try the live demo
cta.body: A seeded database with three branches, four roles, 16 medicines and a full working POS is a click away.
